title: Strategic Interview Positioning under Uncertain Self-Rank
summary: We study interview positioning in the secretary problem when an applicant is uncertain about their own absolute rank. The employer uses a given rejection threshold, and the applicant's self-rank distribution is truncated geometric. We show that the applicant need only compare the first eligible position with the final position and that, for finite $n$, a unique critical value exists precisely when $r(r+1)>n-1$.
